verdict.rationale: Viam documents ready-made hardware drivers pulled automatically from its Registry once you specify the model in config. It also documents a uniform API per component type (e.g., every camera exposes GetImage(), and the same applies to sensors), plus hardware search, a discovery service that suggests component configurations, and built-in data capture. Cameras are explicitly evidenced, but the other named sensor types are not. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of lidar, IMU and GPS drivers or their standard interfaces (movement sensor, point clouds), and independent hands-on corroboration of driver coverage.
